patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used for content sections, pairing a large image or illustration with descriptive text and calls to action.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings (e.g., 'Advance up to $750', 'Boost your credit score') contrast sharply with smaller, lighter body text, establishing a clear visual hierarchy.
A high-contrast black and white base is consistently accented with bright, almost neon, blues, greens, and yellows, primarily in custom illustrations and interactive elements.
A persistent 'Get the app' banner slides in from the bottom right and remains sticky as the user scrolls, providing a continuous call to action.
The main navigation bar transforms from a transparent overlay to a solid white background with a subtle shadow upon scroll, sticking to the top of the viewport.
Sections often feature large, custom illustrations or photography that are integral to conveying the product's benefits, rather than generic stock imagery, giving a distinct brand feel.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay to a solid white background with a subtle drop shadow as the user scrolls past the hero section, remaining fixed at the top of the viewport.
A persistent call-to-action banner for the mobile app appears from the bottom right of the screen after a short scroll and remains sticky, providing a constant prompt to download.

Content sections are structured with a clean, spacious layout, often using a two-column arrangement where one side features a prominent, custom illustration or photograph and the other contains descriptive text and calls to action.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, often using a single large number or phrase for impact, while body text is highly legible and well-spaced.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied to interactive elements like buttons and input fields, and some card-like containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, especially in the hero and primary content sections, with ample whitespace around elements to enhance readability and visual breathing room.

standout: The site's distinctive use of vibrant, almost electric, custom illustrations and photography against a minimalist black and white canvas creates a modern, energetic, and approachable feel for a financial service. The persistent 'Get the app' banner is also a notable, direct conversion strategy.
